title: After-Hours and Weekend Installation Visits — TimeBank Multiplier Table
content:
Installation band schedule, TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: the block hours of an installation visit resolved on a Saturday or Sunday are multiplied by the block's holiday multiplier; those of a weekday installation visit resolved in the onsite after-hours class, by the block's after-hours multiplier; those of a weekday business-hours installation visit, by 1. The draw is recorded in the band its multiplier came from: holiday for the weekend multiplier, after-hours for the after-hours multiplier and business hours otherwise.

| Resolution of the visit's ticket | Multiplier | Band recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Saturday or Sunday | holiday multiplier of the size | holiday |
| Monday to Friday, onsite after-hours class | after-hours multiplier of the size | after-hours |
| Monday to Friday, onsite business-hours class | 1 | business hours |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block (holiday multiplier 2.0, after-hours multiplier 1.5) for an installation converting to 4.00 hours before this multiplier: 8.00 hours on a Saturday, 6.00 hours on a weekday evening, 4.00 hours in weekday business hours.
